subtitle: Light data pull: 8 quarters of revenue, operating profit and net profit (no narrative report)
limitations: Quarterly figures are the company's preliminary (잠정) earnings releases, not DART filings.
Net profit is total net income including non-controlling interests, so it is not comparable with other companies' attributable net profit.
Cash flow, capex, debt and cash were not verified (DART viewer blocked) and are not shown.
Light data pull only: no valuation, no opinion, no fact-check pass, no DART/SEC body or notes review beyond what is listed under sources.
Company IR releases (hyundaimotorgroup.com) read directly in the earlier pilot; values converted from KRW 100 million (억원). Net profit includes non-controlling interests.
